snippet.title: Palace of Poetry UT Japan Lab - Texas Student Research Showdown
snippet.description:
Video submission for UT Austin's Texas Student Research Showdown for the Palace of Poetry: Love Through the Seasons. One of the games made as part of UT Japan Lab's Fall 2023 semester under the Playing Palace Politics project.

Developers: Melanie Quintero, Elizabeth Kinerk, Ana Metelski, Katherine Le, and Tuan Nguyen

Supervised by Dr. Megan Gilbert
